 Judgment

The reliefs sought for in this writ petition are as follows:
"(i)To issue a writ of mandamus, or any other appropriate writ, order or direction directing the 2nd respondent to permit the petitioner to shift the operations of its business to the new premises at Building No. 30/1086- 7,Thaikattuserry, Ollur P.O - 680306, Thrissur and to record the same in the loan documents.
(ii)To issue a writ of mandamus, or any other appropriate writ, order or direction directing the 2nd respondent to permit the petitioner to relocate its functioning to a new premise and not to resort to coercive steps like recalling the loan sanctioned. "
2. The petitioner is engaged in the running of food processing units and claims to be duly licensed.
Petitioner intends to shift its operations from the existing building to a new building bearing No.30/1086-, Thaikkattuserry, Ollur P.O,Thrissur.

When the proposal to shift its operations was intimated to the 2nd respondent, it refused permission as per Ext.P9, pointing out a large amount of arrears remaining as 2026:KER:4822 overdue from the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner has approached this Court seeking the reliefs mentioned above.
3. By a judgment in WP(C) No.22733 of 2025, this Court has already directed the petitioner to repay the entire amount of arrears in 10 equated monthly instalments commencing from 20.02.2026.
A direction has also been issued to pay the regular EMI's also, apart from the instalment of arrears.

The grievance of the respondents that the petitioner cannot shift the building without clearing the arrears, to a large extent, has been redressed by virtue of the direction in WP(C) No.22733 of 2025.
4. The learned Standing Counsel, upon instructions submitted that, if the petitioner clears a substantial portion of the arrears, they are willing to issue the permission to shift the premises.
In the light of the above submission, I am of the view that the writ petition can be disposed of with a direction.
